# ga_bad_no_transfer_proof (golden-bad #1: a FALSE transfer claim)

Removing `TOY-GATE-REMOVED` again, but this time claiming transfer to
`TOY-GATE-SURVIVOR-NARROW` (`_shared/gates/gate_survivor_narrow.sh`), which
does NOT absorb `BANNED_PATTERN_X` (only `BANNED_PATTERN_Y`). The cited
transfer-run log at `_shared/transfer_runs/bad_transfer_run.log` is REAL
captured evidence (generated by actually running
`gate_survivor_narrow.sh targets/has_pattern_x.txt` during authoring): it
shows the narrow survivor genuinely exits 0 (PASSes — does NOT fail) on the
removed gate's planted mutation target. The transfer claim is therefore
FALSE — this is the exact class the audit exists to catch, and it must
name WHY it refuses (never a bare exit 1 with no reason).

`gate_audit.py check-removal` MUST REFUSE this removal.
